column1: # DevLys shares the Remington keystroke layout with Kruti Dev, so the bulk of
# the table is identical. This file inherits Kruti Dev 010 and lists only the
# slots that are known to differ. Add overrides here as your gold set finds
# them -- do NOT fork the whole table.
# !!! The override list below is a STARTING POINT and is the least-verified
# !!! part of this codebase. Treat every DevLys conversion as suspect until
# !!! you have gold pairs covering it.

column3: DevLys uses this slot for tta+tta, KrutiDev for dda+dda
